_doc: EVO lever registry (Owner y 2026-11-12, EVO-PLAN.md). One entry per method lever. family = mechanism family (a research transition must change it). kind = exploit | research | repair (repair levers only repair an instrument). requires = product-relative files that must exist. status open|retired; retired levers name the negative row and its reopen condition. The autopilot adds history-based retirements in state.json, never here.

KSR.what: fwidth operator on frozen held-out CNM cohorts, then certification through the unchanged certify.decide (S28K certified 15; S30K 16 exact all refused TARGET_UNPROVEN).

The 16 S30K held-out exacts were refused TARGET_UNPROVEN (ids absent from the ksr-v5r-s25stage target oracle) and A2_POPULATION_EMPTY (partner pool built from the wrong set; S32K H-A2 SUPPORTED, control 15/15). Extend target-oracle coverage for exactly these ids from ORIGINAL DOL bytes with an independent reader (the S26C C1 method: own DOL and ELF readers, positive and shift negative controls), build the A2 partner pool from the main-capsule hash and size, then certify through the UNCHANGED certify.decide of profile ksr-v5r-s25stage into a separate receipts file. If that profile cannot read the extended oracle unchanged, stop and report INSTRUMENT_FAIL: a profile change is an Owner act. Rival hypotheses: (a) the 16 certify once covered; (b) they fail the oracle or a control (a target mismatch the refusal was hiding).

45 BINARY_EXACT from the fixed S26C '?' fallback (t1 8057ec26): exclude ids certified in any receipts file, then certify through the unchanged certify.decide of profile ksr-v5r-s25stage with the S26D controls (pre/post, A2 negatives from a pool that contains the claims, historical receipts byte-identical) into a separate receipts file. Rival hypotheses: (a) most certify; (b) the fallback source changes bytes of partners (A2 violations).

Owner 2026-11-13 ('y, presupuesto 300M', lane envelope 300M): operator coverage for the 3,653 NO_OPERATOR_FOR_CLASS ids of the S36K sweep. New route code in a new generation (existing route tools stay frozen); a frozen pilot committed before the draw; an independent oracle on the original DOL; a gate with planted mutants; certification only through the unchanged certify.decide. Its certificates land in an additive profile proposed in ONE phase line that states: an independent target oracle on the original DOL bytes; a frozen pilot committed before the draw; pre/post controls; A2 negatives; historical receipts byte-identical; separate counters. Its receipts file gets a receipt_registry.json entry. Rival hypotheses: (a) a bounded operator set makes a measurable share of the 3,653 compile to BINARY_EXACT; (b) the class gaps are type/context gaps an operator cannot close (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

A second independent TU-boundary signal from sbss/bss reference ownership (S32K UKDL candidate c), pre-registered with a positive control on real TU boundaries (not consecutive objects), before any arm field is read. Diagnostic only; no certificate.

Repair the S32K TU-boundary calibration: the control set must be real TU boundaries (S32K recall 0.613 on consecutive-object pairs; AMD-1 n=0 because carved single-fn objects sit between auto_03 pairs). Build the calibration set from boundaries that are independently known, demonstrate its size at freeze, keep the 0.80 bar.

The broad compiler swap matched 0.38 pct of CNM (negative row; reopen if a fingerprint-chosen subset predicts >= 5 pct). S26F W3 found a size<=32 selector with 7.4x held-out enrichment: pre-register that subset prediction on a fresh frozen cohort. Diagnostic only, no certificate: a profile change is an Owner act.

KSR.reopen: a type source that beats the shuffled-type control by >= 5pp with 0 certified regressions
KSR.what: Global type context from lifted signatures (S30T REFUTED: gain came from having prototypes, not true types; 33 certified regressions).

Rival hypotheses: (a) a bounded variant search makes a measurable share of the residual BINARY_EXACT; (b) the residual differences are register-allocation or scheduling effects no source variant reaches (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

Owner 2026-11-14: a whole-program KSR type model, not a per-function repair: callee prototypes by majority over EVERY call site of the program, struct layouts unioned per global symbol across all functions, iterated to a fixpoint, emitted as per-function source declarations only (no canonical ctx/header write). Known evidence against: on Tennis P1, P1c, P1d and P1e (call-graph propagation) were REFUTED and type repair gave compile without match; so the pre-registered outcome is BINARY_EXACT, never compile. New route code in a new generation (existing route tools stay frozen); a frozen pilot committed before the draw; an independent oracle on the original DOL; a gate with planted mutants; certification only through the unchanged certify.decide. Rival hypotheses: (a) whole-program consistency makes a measurable share of NO_COMPILE ids BINARY_EXACT; (b) it moves them to COMPILES_NO_EXACT only (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

TENNIS.what: Owner 2026-11-13 ('y', TENNIS envelope 50M): transfer of the KSR q_fallback route (S26C '?' fallback fix, t1 8057ec26; 31 KSR certificates in S35K) to Tennis. Import the frozen route tool read-only from /home/kobii/missions/t1-campaign at a pinned commit (never edit it) and run it over the uncertified Tennis main functions (Tennis 1,198 / 1,797 certified). Certification only through the unchanged certify.decide under an existing Tennis profile. An additive profile, if one is needed, is proposed in ONE phase line that states: an independent target oracle on the original DOL bytes; a frozen pilot committed before the draw; pre/post controls; A2 negatives; historical receipts byte-identical; separate counters. Rival hypotheses: (a) the fallback converts Tennis question-mark-type compile failures as it did on KSR; (b) the Tennis failures are of another class (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

Owner 2026-11-13 ('y', TENNIS envelope 50M): transfer of the KSR S37K operator route to Tennis (s37-callee: 16/40 held-out then 40/117 on KSR CALL_CRCLR; save-area operators were 0/260 and are not transferred). Import the frozen operators and driver read-only from /home/kobii/missions/t1-campaign at a pinned commit (never edit them), census the Tennis COMPILES_NO_MATCH by class, pilot on a frozen held-out draw. Certification only through the unchanged certify.decide under an existing Tennis profile. An additive profile, if one is needed, is proposed in ONE phase line that states: an independent target oracle on the original DOL bytes; a frozen pilot committed before the draw; pre/post controls; A2 negatives; historical receipts byte-identical; separate counters. Rival hypotheses: (a) the call-shape operator converts a measurable share of the Tennis call-shape class as on KSR; (b) the Tennis gaps are type/context gaps (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

TENNIS.retired_by: S33T-P1-CONTROL-POOL-N12 (worktree-s33t e103a62f: widened pool n=12 < 22; S31T frozen rule n=2): the B1-T planted-positive control cannot be built
